------------------------------ MODULE W4Od0m2p2t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Rooms, Total, MaxAmt

NoTxn == [room |-> "none", amt |-> 0, dir |-> "none"]

VARIABLES pool, alloc, phase, ballots, pending

vars == <<pool, alloc, phase, ballots, pending>>

RECURSIVE SumOf(_)
SumOf(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
            ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
                 IN alloc[x] + SumOf(S \ {x})

Committed == SumOf(Rooms)

Init ==
    /\ pool = Total
    /\ alloc = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ ballots = {}
    /\ pending = NoTxn

ProposeToRoom(r, k) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ k \in 1..MaxAmt
    /\ k <= pool
    /\ pending' = [room |-> r, amt |-> k, dir |-> "toRoom"]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ ballots' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, alloc>>

ProposeToPool(r, k) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ k \in 1..MaxAmt
    /\ k <= alloc[r]
    /\ pending' = [room |-> r, amt |-> k, dir |-> "toPool"]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ ballots' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, alloc>>

CastVote(r, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A b \in ballots : b.room # r
    /\ ballots' = ballots \cup {[room |-> r, vote |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, alloc, phase, pending>>

Decide ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality(ballots) = Cardinality(Rooms)
    /\ IF \A b \in ballots : b.vote = "yes"
       THEN /\ IF pending.dir = "toRoom"
               THEN /\ pool' = pool - pending.amt
                    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![pending.room] = @ + pending.amt]
               ELSE /\ pool' = pool + pending.amt
                    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![pending.room] = @ - pending.amt]
            /\ phase' = "committed"
       ELSE /\ phase' = "aborted"
            /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, alloc>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, pending>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ ballots' = {}
    /\ pending' = NoTxn
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, alloc>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Rooms, k \in 1..MaxAmt : ProposeToRoom(r, k)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms, k \in 1..MaxAmt : ProposeToPool(r, k)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms, v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(r, v)
    \/ Decide
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BudgetConserved == pool + Committed = Total

================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Rooms = {r1, r2}
    Total = 4
    MaxAmt = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BudgetConserved
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler distributes a fixed budget of surgical hours among several operating rooms using a two-phase commit protocol. All hours start in a shared free pool. To move hours the coordinator first opens a transaction: either drawing an amount from the pool into a specific room, or releasing an amount from a room back into the pool. Each room then casts a yes or no ballot on the proposed transaction; because the network delivers ballots out of order, votes are collected as an unordered set and may arrive in any sequence. Once every room has voted, the coordinator decides: if all ballots are yes it commits the transfer in the proposed direction, otherwise it aborts and changes nothing. After a decision the coordinator resets so the next transaction can begin. No matter how transactions interleave or which direction they run, hours are only ever transferred between pool and rooms, never minted or discarded.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The free pool plus the sum of hours committed across all operating rooms always equals the fixed total budget, so no surgical hours are ever created or destroyed.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m9p2t5 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Machines, Total, MaxMove, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES epoch, mepoch, vault, cash

vars == <<epoch, mepoch, vault, cash>>

RECURSIVE SumCash(_)
SumCash(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
              ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
                   IN cash[x] + SumCash(S \ {x})

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ mepoch = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ vault = Total
    /\ cash = [m \in Machines |-> 0]

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<mepoch, vault, cash>>

Sync(m) ==
    /\ mepoch[m] # epoch
    /\ mepoch' = [mepoch EXCEPT ![m] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, vault, cash>>

LoadFloat(m, k) ==
    /\ mepoch[m] = epoch
    /\ k \in 1..MaxMove
    /\ k <= vault
    /\ vault' = vault - k
    /\ cash' = [cash EXCEPT ![m] = @ + k]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, mepoch>>

Sweep(m, k) ==
    /\ mepoch[m] = epoch
    /\ k \in 1..MaxMove
    /\ k <= cash[m]
    /\ cash' = [cash EXCEPT ![m] = @ - k]
    /\ vault' = vault + k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, mepoch>>

AdminRebalance(m, k, toM) ==
    /\ k \in 1..MaxMove
    /\ IF toM
       THEN /\ k <= vault
            /\ vault' = vault - k
            /\ cash' = [cash EXCEPT ![m] = @ + k]
       ELSE /\ k <= cash[m]
            /\ cash' = [cash EXCEPT ![m] = @ - k]
            /\ vault' = vault + k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, mepoch>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Sync(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, k \in 1..MaxMove : LoadFloat(m, k)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, k \in 1..MaxMove : Sweep(m, k)
    \/ \E m \in Machines, k \in 1..MaxMove, toM \in {TRUE, FALSE} : AdminRebalance(m, k, toM)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CoinsConserved == vault + SumCash(Machines) = Total

================================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Machines = {a, b}
    Total = 3
    MaxMove = 2
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CoinsConserved
nl:
A network of vending machines shares a fixed supply of coins used to make change. Coins live either in a central vault or as float loaded into individual machines. The operator periodically issues a new configuration generation (an epoch bump); each machine must adopt the current epoch before it is allowed to load float from, or sweep float back to, the vault under normal operation. A privileged administrator can additionally rebalance coins between the vault and any machine at any time, ignoring the epoch handshake entirely as an override. Loading moves coins from the vault into a machine, sweeping moves them back, and every such move only shifts coins from one place to another. Regardless of how epochs advance, which machines have synced, or how the admin intervenes, coins are never manufactured or thrown away.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The coins in the central vault plus the sum of float across all vending machines always equals the fixed total coin supply.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m0p2t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cranes, Stacks, Total

NoStage == [stack |-> "none", dir |-> "none", snap |-> 0]

VARIABLES cargo, ship, ver, staged, alive

vars == <<cargo, ship, ver, staged, alive>>

RECURSIVE SumCargo(_)
SumCargo(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
               ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
                    IN cargo[x] + SumCargo(S \ {x})

Feasible(s, d) == IF d = "load" THEN cargo[s] > 0 ELSE ship > 0

Init ==
    /\ cargo = [s \in Stacks |-> 0]
    /\ ship = Total
    /\ ver = [s \in Stacks |-> 0]
    /\ staged = [c \in Cranes |-> NoStage]
    /\ alive = [c \in Cranes |-> TRUE]

Stage(c, s, d) ==
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ staged[c] = NoStage
    /\ Feasible(s, d)
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![c] = [stack |-> s, dir |-> d, snap |-> ver[s]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cargo, ship, ver, alive>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ staged[c] # NoStage
    /\ LET g == staged[c] IN
        /\ ver[g.stack] = g.snap
        /\ Feasible(g.stack, g.dir)
        /\ IF g.dir = "load"
           THEN /\ cargo' = [cargo EXCEPT ![g.stack] = @ - 1]
                /\ ship' = ship + 1
           ELSE /\ ship' = ship - 1
                /\ cargo' = [cargo EXCEPT ![g.stack] = @ + 1]
        /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![g.stack] = (@ + 1) % 3]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![c] = NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED alive

Retry(c) ==
    /\ staged[c] # NoStage
    /\ LET g == staged[c] IN
        \/ ver[g.stack] # g.snap
        \/ ~Feasible(g.stack, g.dir)
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![c] = NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cargo, ship, ver, alive>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![c] = NoStage]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cargo, ship, ver>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ ~alive[c]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cargo, ship, ver, staged>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Stacks, d \in {"load", "unload"} : Stage(c, s, d)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Commit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Retry(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Recover(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ContainersConserved == ship + SumCargo(Stacks) = Total

================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    Stacks = {s1, s2}
    Total = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ContainersConserved
nl:
A container-ship crane yard moves shipping containers between fixed yard stacks and the ship using several cranes that coordinate with optimistic locking. Each stack carries a version counter. To move a container, a crane snapshots a stack's version and stages an intended transfer (loading a container from a stack onto the ship, or unloading one back to a stack). The crane commits only if the stack's version is unchanged since its snapshot and the move is still feasible, in which case it performs the transfer and bumps the version; otherwise it discards the attempt and retries later. A crane may crash silently at any moment, in which case its staged-but-uncommitted intent is simply dropped and no container moves; a crashed crane can later recover. Because every committed move only relocates a container and dropped attempts move nothing, the containers are neither created nor lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of containers on the ship plus the sum of containers across all yard stacks always equals the fixed total number of containers.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m2p2t1 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Branches, Total, MaxAmt

NoTxn == [from |-> "none", to |-> "none", amt |-> 0]

VARIABLES units, phase, txn, votes

vars == <<units, phase, txn, votes>>

RECURSIVE SumUnits(_)
SumUnits(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
               ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
                    IN units[x] + SumUnits(S \ {x})

Init ==
    /\ units = [b \in Branches |-> Total \div Cardinality(Branches)]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ txn = NoTxn
    /\ votes = {}

Begin(x, y, k) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ x # y
    /\ k \in 1..MaxAmt
    /\ k <= units[x]
    /\ txn' = [from |-> x, to |-> y, amt |-> k]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED units

Vote(b, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ b \in {txn.from, txn.to}
    /\ \A e \in votes : e.branch # b
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[branch |-> b, vote |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<units, phase, txn>>

BothVoted == Cardinality(votes) = 2

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ BothVoted
    /\ \A e \in votes : e.vote = "yes"
    /\ units' = [units EXCEPT ![txn.from] = @ - txn.amt, ![txn.to] = @ + txn.amt]
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, votes>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ BothVoted
    /\ \E e \in votes : e.vote = "no"
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<units, txn, votes>>

Close ==
    /\ phase = "done"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ txn' = NoTxn
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED units

Next ==
    \/ \E x \in Branches, y \in Branches, k \in 1..MaxAmt : Begin(x, y, k)
    \/ \E b \in Branches, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(b, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Close

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

StockConserved == SumUnits(Branches) = Total

================================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Branches = {a, b, c}
    Total = 6
    MaxAmt = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT StockConserved
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker coordinates transfers of blood units between branch fridges using two-phase commit. A transfer names a source branch, a destination branch, and an amount to move. Once a transfer is opened, both the source and destination branches must vote on it; because branch replies travel over an unreliable link and can arrive in any order, votes are gathered as an unordered set. When both branches have voted, the coordinator decides: if both voted yes it commits, decrementing the source and incrementing the destination by the amount, otherwise it aborts and leaves every fridge untouched. After the decision the coordinator closes out the transfer so a new one can open. Since a commit only relocates units from one fridge to another and an abort moves nothing, the overall stock is preserved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The sum of blood units across all branch fridges always equals the fixed total stock, so units are never created or destroyed by any transfer.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od4m6p2t4 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Owners, Total, MaxCap, LeaseDur, MaxClock

NoLease == [owner |-> "none", exp |-> 0]

VARIABLES waiting, online, done, lease, clock, cap

vars == <<waiting, online, done, lease, clock, cap>>

ValidLease == lease.owner # "none" /\ clock < lease.exp

Init ==
    /\ waiting = Total
    /\ online = 0
    /\ done = 0
    /\ lease = NoLease
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ cap = 1

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, online, done, lease, cap>>

Acquire(o) ==
    /\ ~ValidLease
    /\ lease' = [owner |-> o, exp |-> clock + LeaseDur]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, online, done, clock, cap>>

Renew ==
    /\ ValidLease
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT !.exp = clock + LeaseDur]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, online, done, clock, cap>>

Admit ==
    /\ ValidLease
    /\ waiting > 0
    /\ online < cap
    /\ waiting' = waiting - 1
    /\ online' = online + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<done, lease, clock, cap>>

Finish ==
    /\ ValidLease
    /\ online > 0
    /\ online' = online - 1
    /\ done' = done + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, lease, clock, cap>>

SetCap(nc) ==
    /\ nc # cap
    /\ cap' = nc
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, online, done, lease, clock>>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E o \in Owners : Acquire(o)
    \/ Renew
    \/ Admit
    \/ Finish
    \/ \E nc \in 0..MaxCap : SetCap(nc)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CarsConserved == waiting + online + done = Total

================================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Owners = {w1, w2}
    Total = 3
    MaxCap = 2
    LeaseDur = 2
    MaxClock = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CarsConserved
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line processes cars through a chain of wash bays controlled by bay controllers that must hold a lease to drive the line. Cars begin in a waiting queue, move onto the line, and eventually leave as finished. A controller acquires a time-limited lease when none is currently valid, and may renew it to extend the expiry; a global clock ticks forward and a lease silently expires once the clock passes its deadline. Only while holding a valid, unexpired lease may a controller admit a waiting car onto the line or finish a car off the line. The number of cars the line can hold at once is a capacity that an operator may raise or lower at runtime, which only gates admissions and never moves cars by itself. Every admit shifts one car from waiting to on-line and every finish shifts one from on-line to finished, so no car is ever conjured up or discarded.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of waiting cars plus cars on the line plus finished cars always equals the fixed total number of cars in the system.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m5p3t0 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Agents, Voters, Chutes, Quorum

VARIABLES holder, held, pending, approvals, up

vars == <<holder, held, pending, approvals, up>>

NoReq == [active |-> FALSE, chute |-> "none"]

Init ==
    /\ holder = [c \in Chutes |-> "free"]
    /\ held = [a \in Agents |-> {}]
    /\ pending = [a \in Agents |-> NoReq]
    /\ approvals = [a \in Agents |-> {}]
    /\ up = [v \in Voters |-> TRUE]

OpenReq(a, c) ==
    /\ ~pending[a].active
    /\ holder[c] = "free"
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![a] = [active |-> TRUE, chute |-> c]]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![a] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, held, up>>

CastApproval(v, a) ==
    /\ up[v]
    /\ pending[a].active
    /\ v \notin approvals[a]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![a] = @ \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, held, pending, up>>

Grant(a) ==
    /\ pending[a].active
    /\ Cardinality(approvals[a]) >= Quorum
    /\ holder[pending[a].chute] = "free"
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![pending[a].chute] = a]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![a] = @ \cup {pending[a].chute}]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![a] = NoReq]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![a] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED up

Release(a, c) ==
    /\ holder[c] = a
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![c] = "free"]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![a] = @ \ {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, approvals, up>>

CrashVoter(v) ==
    /\ up[v]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![v] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, held, pending, approvals>>

RecoverVoter(v) ==
    /\ ~up[v]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![v] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, held, pending, approvals>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents, c \in Chutes : OpenReq(a, c)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, a \in Agents : CastApproval(v, a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : Grant(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, c \in Chutes : Release(a, c)
    \/ \E v \in Voters : CrashVoter(v)
    \/ \E v \in Voters : RecoverVoter(v)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoConflictingClaims ==
    \A a \in Agents : \A c \in held[a] : holder[c] = a

================================================================================
nl:
An airport baggage router assigns physical outgoing chutes to routing agents, where each chute may be dedicated to at most one agent at a time. To claim a free chute an agent opens a request, and a set of voter nodes must approve it; the agent is granted the chute only once a quorum of voters has approved and the chute is still free, at which point ownership is recorded both in the central chute ledger and in the agent's own set of held chutes. An agent can later release a chute it holds, returning it to the free pool. Any voter may crash silently and stop approving, and a crashed voter can later recover; if too many voters are down a request simply cannot reach quorum. The protocol must never let a request slip through that hands an already-owned chute to a second agent.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No chute is ever simultaneously listed as held by two different routing agents; every chute an agent believes it holds is recorded to that same agent in the central ledger.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m5p3t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Instances, Voters, Seats, Quorum

VARIABLES pool, committed, pending, approvals

vars == <<pool, committed, pending, approvals>>

Init ==
    /\ pool = Seats
    /\ committed = [i \in Instances |-> {}]
    /\ pending = [i \in Instances |-> "none"]
    /\ approvals = [i \in Instances |-> {}]

Propose(i, s) ==
    /\ pending[i] = "none"
    /\ s \in pool
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = s]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, committed>>

Approve(v, i) ==
    /\ pending[i] # "none"
    /\ v \notin approvals[i]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, committed, pending>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ pending[i] # "none"
    /\ Cardinality(approvals[i]) >= Quorum
    /\ pending[i] \in pool
    /\ pool' = pool \ {pending[i]}
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {pending[i]}]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = "none"]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![i] = {}]

Vacate(i, s) ==
    /\ s \in committed[i]
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![i] = @ \ {s}]
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, approvals>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Seats : Propose(i, s)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, i \in Instances : Approve(v, i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Seats : Vacate(i, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoCrossInstanceDoubleBooking ==
    \A i \in Instances, j \in Instances :
        i # j => committed[i] \cap committed[j] = {}

================================================================================
nl:
A university course-registration system runs two independent registration instances that both draw seats from a single shared seat pool. When an instance wants to enroll a student into a specific seat, it proposes that seat and a council of voter nodes must approve; the instance commits the seat only once a quorum has approved and the seat is still in the shared pool. Committing removes the seat from the pool and records it in that instance's committed set. An instance may later vacate a seat it committed, returning it to the shared pool for reuse. Because both instances compete for the same pool but a seat can only be committed while it is still free, the two instances must never both end up owning the same seat.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The sets of seats committed by the two registration instances are always disjoint, so no seat is ever double-allocated across instances.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m0p3t1 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Workers, Shelves

VARIABLES shelfOwner, shelfVer, owns, reqs

vars == <<shelfOwner, shelfVer, owns, reqs>>

Init ==
    /\ shelfOwner = [s \in Shelves |-> "free"]
    /\ shelfVer = [s \in Shelves |-> 0]
    /\ owns = [w \in Workers |-> {}]
    /\ reqs = {}

SubmitReq(w, s) ==
    /\ \A r \in reqs : ~(r.worker = w /\ r.shelf = s)
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {[worker |-> w, shelf |-> s, snap |-> shelfVer[s]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfOwner, shelfVer, owns>>

CommitReq(r) ==
    /\ r \in reqs
    /\ shelfOwner[r.shelf] = "free"
    /\ shelfVer[r.shelf] = r.snap
    /\ shelfOwner' = [shelfOwner EXCEPT ![r.shelf] = r.worker]
    /\ shelfVer' = [shelfVer EXCEPT ![r.shelf] = (@ + 1) % 3]
    /\ owns' = [owns EXCEPT ![r.worker] = @ \cup {r.shelf}]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {r}

RejectReq(r) ==
    /\ r \in reqs
    /\ \/ shelfOwner[r.shelf] # "free"
       \/ shelfVer[r.shelf] # r.snap
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelfOwner, shelfVer, owns>>

Release(w, s) ==
    /\ shelfOwner[s] = w
    /\ shelfOwner' = [shelfOwner EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
    /\ shelfVer' = [shelfVer EXCEPT ![s] = (@ + 1) % 3]
    /\ owns' = [owns EXCEPT ![w] = @ \ {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED reqs

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers, s \in Shelves : SubmitReq(w, s)
    \/ \E r \in reqs : CommitReq(r)
    \/ \E r \in reqs : RejectReq(r)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, s \in Shelves : Release(w, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OwnershipConsistent ==
    \A w \in Workers : \A s \in owns[w] : shelfOwner[s] = w

================================================================================
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker assigns individual fridge shelves to storage workers so that each shelf holds at most one worker's consignment. Coordination uses optimistic locking: every shelf carries a version stamp, and a worker submits a claim request capturing the shelf's current version. Because requests flow over a queue that delivers them out of order, pending requests are held as an unordered set and may be committed or rejected in any sequence. A request commits only if the shelf is still free and its version stamp is unchanged since the request was made, in which case the shelf's owner is recorded, the worker adds the shelf to its own held set, and the version is bumped; otherwise the stale request is rejected and the worker must retry. A worker may release a shelf it owns, freeing it and bumping the version. The tracker must never let a stale, reordered request hand a shelf to a worker while another worker still holds it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every shelf that a worker holds in its own set is recorded to that same worker in the central shelf ledger, so no shelf is ever double-allocated to two workers.

----------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m9p3t1 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Drones, Sectors, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES epoch, dEpoch, assignedTo, covering, claims

vars == <<epoch, dEpoch, assignedTo, covering, claims>>

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ dEpoch = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ assignedTo = [s \in Sectors |-> "none"]
    /\ covering = [d \in Drones |-> {}]
    /\ claims = {}

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dEpoch, assignedTo, covering, claims>>

SyncDrone(d) ==
    /\ dEpoch[d] # epoch
    /\ dEpoch' = [dEpoch EXCEPT ![d] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, assignedTo, covering, claims>>

Claim(d, s) ==
    /\ \A c \in claims : ~(c.drone = d /\ c.sector = s)
    /\ claims' = claims \cup {[drone |-> d, sector |-> s, ep |-> dEpoch[d]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, dEpoch, assignedTo, covering>>

ApplyClaim(c) ==
    /\ c \in claims
    /\ c.ep = epoch
    /\ assignedTo[c.sector] = "none"
    /\ assignedTo' = [assignedTo EXCEPT ![c.sector] = c.drone]
    /\ covering' = [covering EXCEPT ![c.drone] = @ \cup {c.sector}]
    /\ claims' = claims \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, dEpoch>>

DropClaim(c) ==
    /\ c \in claims
    /\ \/ c.ep # epoch
       \/ assignedTo[c.sector] # "none"
    /\ claims' = claims \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, dEpoch, assignedTo, covering>>

Release(d, s) ==
    /\ assignedTo[s] = d
    /\ assignedTo' = [assignedTo EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ covering' = [covering EXCEPT ![d] = @ \ {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, dEpoch, claims>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E d \in Drones : SyncDrone(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : Claim(d, s)
    \/ \E c \in claims : ApplyClaim(c)
    \/ \E c \in claims : DropClaim(c)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : Release(d, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CONSTANTS

    Sectors = {x1, x2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SectorsNotShared
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm divides the fire perimeter into sectors and assigns each sector to at most one drone. A ground coordinator periodically issues a new configuration epoch, and each drone must adopt the current epoch before its claims count. To take a sector, a drone submits a claim tagged with the epoch it currently holds; because the radio mesh delivers claims out of order, claims are buffered as an unordered set and processed in any sequence. A claim is applied only if it carries the current epoch and the sector is still unassigned, at which point the sector's owner is recorded and the drone adds it to its own coverage; a claim carrying a stale epoch, or targeting an already-assigned sector, is dropped. A drone may release a sector it covers. Despite reordering and stale epochs, no sector may ever be covered by two drones at once.

Bays == Lanes \X BayIx
LaneOf(b) == b[1]

VARIABLES coarseHolder, fineHolder, workerBays, alive

vars == <<coarseHolder, fineHolder, workerBays, alive>>

Init ==
    /\ coarseHolder = [l \in Lanes |-> "none"]
    /\ fineHolder = [b \in Bays |-> "none"]
    /\ workerBays = [w \in Workers |-> {}]
    /\ alive = [w \in Workers |-> TRUE]

AcquireCoarse(w, l) ==
    /\ alive[w]
    /\ coarseHolder[l] = "none"
    /\ coarseHolder' = [coarseHolder EXCEPT ![l] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineHolder, workerBays, alive>>

AcquireFine(w, b) ==
    /\ alive[w]
    /\ coarseHolder[LaneOf(b)] = w
    /\ fineHolder[b] = "none"
    /\ fineHolder' = [fineHolder EXCEPT ![b] = w]
    /\ workerBays' = [workerBays EXCEPT ![w] = @ \cup {b}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseHolder, alive>>

ReleaseFine(w, b) ==
    /\ fineHolder[b] = w
    /\ fineHolder' = [fineHolder EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
    /\ workerBays' = [workerBays EXCEPT ![w] = @ \ {b}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseHolder, alive>>

ReleaseCoarse(w, l) ==
    /\ coarseHolder[l] = w
    /\ \A b \in Bays : LaneOf(b) = l => fineHolder[b] # w
    /\ coarseHolder' = [coarseHolder EXCEPT ![l] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineHolder, workerBays, alive>>

Crash(w) ==
    /\ alive[w]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![w] = FALSE]
    /\ coarseHolder' = [l \in Lanes |-> IF coarseHolder[l] = w THEN "none" ELSE coarseHolder[l]]
    /\ fineHolder' = [b \in Bays |-> IF fineHolder[b] = w THEN "none" ELSE fineHolder[b]]
    /\ workerBays' = [workerBays EXCEPT ![w] = {}]

Recover(w) ==
    /\ ~alive[w]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![w] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseHolder, fineHolder, workerBays>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers, l \in Lanes : AcquireCoarse(w, l)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, b \in Bays : AcquireFine(w, b)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, b \in Bays : ReleaseFine(w, b)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, l \in Lanes : ReleaseCoarse(w, l)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Crash(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Recover(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HierarchicalSafety ==
    \A w \in Workers : \A b \in workerBays[w] :
        /\ fineHolder[b] = w
        /\ coarseHolder[LaneOf(b)] = w

================================================================================
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line protects its wash bays with a two-level hierarchical lock: a coarse lock over a whole lane, and a fine lock over each individual bay inside that lane. A worker must first acquire the coarse lock on a lane, and only then may it acquire the fine lock on a bay in that lane, recording the bay in its own held set. A worker may release a fine bay it holds, and may release a coarse lane lock only once it holds no fine bay in that lane. A worker can crash silently at any time; when it does, all of its coarse and fine locks are released atomically and its held set is cleared, and the worker may later recover. The discipline must guarantee that a bay is never simultaneously held by two workers, and that whenever a worker holds a bay it also still holds the enclosing lane.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every bay in a worker's held set, that bay is recorded to the same worker in the fine-lock ledger and that worker also holds the coarse lock on the bay's lane.

    /\ UNCHANGED load

    /\ ~slow
    /\ slow' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, leader, term>>

    /\ slow' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, leader, term>>

    /\ ~slow
    /\ load[c] < Cap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, slow>>

    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, slow>>

    \/ Stall
    \/ Resume
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Board(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Alight(c)

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od8m5p4t2 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Instances, Voters, Students, Cap, Quorum

VARIABLES enrolled, pending, approvals

vars == <<enrolled, pending, approvals>>

Init ==
    /\ enrolled = {}
    /\ pending = [i \in Instances |-> "none"]
    /\ approvals = [i \in Instances |-> {}]

Propose(i, st) ==
    /\ pending[i] = "none"
    /\ st \notin enrolled
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = st]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED enrolled

Approve(v, i) ==
    /\ pending[i] # "none"
    /\ v \notin approvals[i]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, pending>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ pending[i] # "none"
    /\ Cardinality(approvals[i]) >= Quorum
    /\ pending[i] \notin enrolled
    /\ Cardinality(enrolled) < Cap
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {pending[i]}
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![i] = "none"]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![i] = {}]

Drop(i, st) ==
    /\ st \in enrolled
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled \ {st}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, approvals>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, st \in Students : Propose(i, st)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, i \in Instances : Approve(v, i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, st \in Students : Drop(i, st)

nl:
A university course-registration system runs two independent registration instances that both enroll students into a single course drawing on one shared roster. The course has a fixed seat capacity. To enroll a student an instance proposes that student, and a council of voter nodes must approve the enrollment; the instance commits the student onto the shared roster only once a quorum has approved, the student is not already enrolled, and there is still a free seat. Either instance may later drop an already-enrolled student, freeing a seat. Because both instances add to the same roster and each checks capacity at commit time, the total number of enrolled students must never exceed the course capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of students on the shared course roster never exceeds the fixed seat capacity.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od11m3p1t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Writers, Ids, MaxTerm

NoPend == [id |-> "none", rv |-> 0]

VARIABLES version, applied, acked, pending, leader, term

vars == <<version, applied, acked, pending, leader, term>>

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ acked = [w \in Writers |-> {}]
    /\ pending = [w \in Writers |-> NoPend]
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ term = 0

Elect(w) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied, acked, pending>>

StageWrite(w, id) ==
    /\ pending[w] = NoPend
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![w] = [id |-> id, rv |-> version]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied, acked, leader, term>>

CommitWrite(w) ==
    /\ pending[w] # NoPend
    /\ leader = w
    /\ version = pending[w].rv
    /\ pending[w].id \notin applied
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {pending[w].id}
    /\ acked' = [acked EXCEPT ![w] = @ \cup {pending[w].id}]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![w] = NoPend]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

AbortWrite(w) ==
    /\ pending[w] # NoPend
    /\ \/ leader # w
       \/ version # pending[w].rv
       \/ pending[w].id \in applied
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![w] = NoPend]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied, acked, leader, term>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Elect(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers, id \in Ids : StageWrite(w, id)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : CommitWrite(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : AbortWrite(w)

    Writers = {w1, w2}
    Ids = {u1, u2}
    MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A print shop job spooler keeps a shared spool record that two independent spooler instances both update, drawing update tickets from one shared pool. A single writer is chosen by leader election using increasing terms, and a rival can fail over by winning a higher term. To update the record a writer first reads the record's current version and stages a ticket; it then commits only if it is the current leader and the record's version is still exactly what it read, in which case the version advances by one, the ticket is marked applied on the record, and the writer remembers it as acknowledged. If the version has moved on since the read, or the writer is no longer leader, the stale attempt is aborted and retried. This read-check-write discipline exists so that a concurrent write can never silently overwrite and lose an update another writer already had acknowledged.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every ticket a writer has acknowledged as committed is always still present in the shared record's set of applied updates, so no acknowledged update is ever lost.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od2m5p1t5 -----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, Voters, Quorum, MaxVer

NoPend == [rv |-> 0, newv |-> 0, active |-> FALSE]

VARIABLES val, ver, ackedVal, pending, approvals

vars == <<val, ver, ackedVal, pending, approvals>>

Init ==
    /\ val = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ ackedVal = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ pending = [r \in Robots |-> NoPend]
    /\ approvals = [r \in Robots |-> {}]

Stage(r) ==
    /\ ~pending[r].active
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![r] = [rv |-> ver, newv |-> val + 1, active |-> TRUE]]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<val, ver, ackedVal>>

Approve(v, r) ==
    /\ pending[r].active
    /\ v \notin approvals[r]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![r] = @ \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<val, ver, ackedVal, pending>>

Commit(r) ==
    /\ pending[r].active
    /\ Cardinality(approvals[r]) >= Quorum
    /\ ver = pending[r].rv
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ val' = pending[r].newv
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ ackedVal' = [ackedVal EXCEPT ![r] = pending[r].newv]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![r] = NoPend]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![r] = {}]

Abort(r) ==
    /\ pending[r].active
    /\ ver # pending[r].rv
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![r] = NoPend]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<val, ver, ackedVal>>

AdminBump ==
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ val' = val + 1
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ackedVal, pending, approvals>>

Rollover ==
    /\ ver = MaxVer
    /\ val' = 0
    /\ ver' = 0
    /\ ackedVal' = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ pending' = [r \in Robots |-> NoPend]
    /\ approvals' = [r \in Robots |-> {}]

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Stage(r)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, r \in Robots : Approve(v, r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Commit(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Abort(r)
    \/ AdminBump
    \/ Rollover

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AckedNeverLost == \A r \in Robots : ackedVal[r] <= val

    Voters = {v1, v2, v3}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AckedNeverLost
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet maintains one shared status record (a versioned counter) that robots update by read-modify-write, with each update requiring quorum approval from a set of voter nodes. A robot stages an update by reading the current version and proposing the next value; voters approve, and the robot commits only if a quorum approved and the version is still the one it read, at which point the value advances, the version increments, and the robot remembers the value it wrote as acknowledged. If the version has moved on, the stale attempt is aborted. A privileged administrator may override the quorum and bump the record directly. When the version reaches its ceiling the record is archived and reinitialized as a fresh generation, resetting acknowledged values as well. This read-check-write scheme ensures a concurrent update can never quietly clobber a value a robot already had acknowledged.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every value a robot has acknowledged as committed is always less than or equal to the shared record's current value, so no acknowledged update is ever overwritten and lost.
